name: SPECTRAL_INITIAL_RESPONSE_AND_THERMAL_SIGN
primary_question: Determine the energy and positive-spectrum dependence of the leading initial HII and temperature shear responses at the actual fixed gas initial state.
motivation: Classify the robustness or failure of the PHYS22 soft-photon signs before building broader spectral or coupled histories.

energy_domain.diagnostic_family: isotropic physical photon number measure with support separated from thresholds; fixed total N0 first; fixed energy normalization separately defined
energy_domain.extension_rule: An analytic sign certificate covering the full open HI-only interval may be stated with explicit support/regularity conditions. No threshold crossing.

conventions.coefficient: [epsilon^2] = one half second epsilon derivative; time coefficient has no additional factorial
conventions.geometry: B=t Sigma, Sigma=shear diag(1,-1,0), q=tr Sigma^2=2 shear^2
conventions.source_constants: exact-real interpretations of source binary64 literals, not native arithmetic emulation
conventions.log_energy_operator: D=E d/dE, C=D(D+3), D holds initial gas state fixed

inherited_closed_formulas.T_t3: q/45 * A_T/Pi * integral C[lambda(E)(E-chi-e_th)] dnu0(E); e_th=3 kB T/(2 eV)
inherited_closed_formulas.birth_delay: same-full-baseline forcing partition starts one time order later

scope: analytic energy log-slope/curvature reduction for the actual HI fit
bounded sign/root structure and appropriate certificate or explicit numerical ceiling
positive spectral measure mixture and normalization dependence
one 13.7 eV link to inherited result, not old suite replay

scope-limited independent final decision and additive docs publication

completion_bar: explicit domain/regularity and source-normalized response functions
